ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the shown image, what is the correct order of development in the life cycle of a butterfly?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a cycle diagram of the butterfly life cycle. On the leaf on the left there is a cluster of eggs, and the arrows point to a small caterpillar and a larger caterpillar; then along the arrows to the pupa/chrysalis stage hanging at the upper right; then to the butterflies after emergence on the right side and below, and the center also shows an adult butterfly. Reasoning: According to the development sequence indicated by the arrows in the figure, the butterfly first starts from the egg, hatches into a larva/caterpillar, then becomes a pupa, and finally develops into an adult butterfly.
